          const cameras = await cameraService.getAll();

            id: c.id,
            name: c.name,

            longitude: c.longitude,

            id: z.id,
            name: z.name,
            latitude: z.latitude || 33.9716,
            longitude: z.longitude || -6.8498,

            zone_radius: z.zone_radius,

            id: v.id,
            name: v.immatriculation,
            latitude: v.latitude,
            longitude: v.longitude,
